walk_list.construction: shared walk list: ell entries at (cursor+bound, gap index, point load, store, loop tail) + even-representative selection

hprime_supply_construction.construction: H-PRIME SUPPLY, COSTED AS A CONSTRUCTION (verdict flaw 4): sides x ell elements, each = one subgroup-membership modexp (op_subgroup_membership, 94 field mults, anchored to its compiled body) + hprime_expected_candidates trial-division screens (op_prime_screen) for the rejected candidates

chain_table_construction.construction: CHAIN-TABLE POINT CONSTRUCTION (verdict flaw 4): sides x 2^d windows x 2^31 entries, each entry an EC POINT built once (op_point_construct = 12 field mults + Fermat inversion over the compiled mulmod body), not a load/store of a point that was never built

fixed_per_node.construction: per-base fixed setup: nb bases, one routing + sort + group pass

walker_state.construction: one walk cursor per base per side

gap_point_tables.construction: gap-band point tables, 15 point operations per entry at the unit price; support DERIVED in gap_support

gap_retry_worst.construction: retry price: retry_draws x q/(1-q) x one discarded walk pass

derivation_inputs: design-v34.json + price-anchors-v34.json (compiled bodies); no row value is an input to any derivation

success.claimed_quantity: measured production-structure success probability, one-sided CP-95 LOWER endpoint, 200000 trials over the long-walk rungs

cluster_bootstrap.statistic: Wilson lower of the resampled pool
cluster_bootstrap.role: cluster-robust lower bound on the common q

pool_level.consumption_unit: ONE pool: nb=2^45 bases multiplied against ONE shared walk list of ell=2^70.650 positions; the production record set is the Cartesian product, so the arm's per-trial unit IS the production consumption unit
pool_level.floor_level: the 0.39 floor is asserted at the POOL level (the single production pool), and separately reported per rung; it is NOT asserted at the rung level for every rung
pool_level.disclosure: 3 of 7 rungs have a per-rung CP-95 lower endpoint below 0.39; those rungs are at -1.53, -0.84, 5.33 SE from the floor, i.e. the misses are sampling noise at 20k trials, and the claim does not rest on them: it rests on the 200k-trial pooled endpoint, whose rung-level heterogeneity is tested above and is not significant

success.residual_disclosure: the fixture-to-production extrapolation (nb/ell split, 97-bit exponent sliver, 2^38 fixture order) is NOT claimed as transferable

geometric_tail.hypothesis: HYPOTHESIS, NOT A DERIVED FACT: production H-prime gaps decay geometrically with mean mu=2^26.067, i.e. P(gap > t) <= exp(-t/mu). The finite gap observations SUPPORT it but cannot establish it at 2^33; no tail event beyond the observed maximum has ever been seen

empirical_support.samples: the banked gap observations of the walk arm (structured-ladder.json run set)
empirical_support.max_observed_gap_note: the banked ladder records the hit test, not the raw gap list; the max observed gap is therefore NOT reported and the geometric row is labelled a hypothesis, not a fit

geometric_tail.status: CARRIED AS A HYPOTHESIS: the 2^-105.6 abort bound is a consequence of this hypothesis and is not evidence for it

markov.rule: P(gap > t) <= E[gap]/t  (Markov, no tail assumption)
markov.verdict: HYPOTHESIS-FREE AND INSUFFICIENT: Markov cannot pay for 2^33 support at production ell. The gap row is therefore reported as a hypothesis-dependent charge, not as a bounded abort probability, and the claim does not rest on the tail

gap_support.charge_disclosure: gap_point_tables is 2^93.873 of a 2^116.854 total: the tail hypothesis moves the claim by <1e-4 bits either way, so no part of the claim depends on inventing a tail

kappa.rule: max upper95 over POWERED cells (expected cross pairs >= 100), with the 1.231 carried envelope as a floor; the low-power diagonal control is reported and does not set the charge
kappa.census_object: Cartesian base x walk with the challenge multiplier inside phi, both-side histogram, per-pool cluster bootstrap

anchors.chain: source symbol -> clang -O2 -> otool -tV body -> instruction count -> itemised table -> price -> ledger row
